north_star.title: Xonotic −40 %
north_star.statement: Ship the complete Xonotic 0.8.6 release in 40 % fewer bytes, from one .vpak: the same game on a real GPU, no slower to load, rebuilt in seconds after an edit — every number reproducible with one command.

gates.target: ≤ 711 MB for all 14,597 files (≤ 0.60× of the 1,185.2 MB shipped pk3 download)
gates.today: 924.6 MB byte-exact (0.780×, compact layout, VXCM backend), every file SHA-256 verified; compact single-file reads p99 373 ms. 27 % of the download is already-compressed .jpg/.ogg, so lossless alone stops far above 711 MB.

gates.target: Every non-texture file byte-identical (SHA-256); JPEG recompression bit-exact
gates.today: Strict mode verified byte-exact on all 14,597 files

gates.target: Every re-encoded DXT texture ≥ 40 dB RGB and alpha against the shipped texture, on every mip level
gates.today: Shipped .dds (DXT1 982 MB, DXT5 621 MB raw) are opaque data; no DDS ingest, no BC3 (DXT5) encoder, no RDO for existing blocks

gates.target: Stock Xonotic 0.8.6 runs from the .vpak through a DarkPlaces filesystem backend on a real GPU: every official map loads, a recorded demo plays to the end, zero missing assets
gates.today: No engine backend; never run on a GPU

gates.target: No map loads slower than from the shipped pk3 files (median of 7 runs); single-asset read p99 ≤ 1 ms
gates.today: Not measured; VXLZ decodes 2.4–4.6× slower than zstd on the same blocks

gates.target: Changing one texture rebuilds the archive in ≤ 5 s on 8 cores; the resulting patch is ≤ 2× that asset’s compressed size
gates.today: Full repack only: 18.0 s (stream) / 250.2 s (compact) on 16 workers; patch size not measured

milestones.title: Spec-conformant GPU blocks
milestones.goal: BC1/BC4/BC5/BC7 blocks decode bit-exactly with an independent reference decoder (Pillow DDS).

milestones.title: Hardened container
milestones.goal: Corrupt or truncated archives raise a clean error; adversarial fuzz tests in Python and Rust.

milestones.title: Portable builds
milestones.goal: pip-installable package with the Rust core; CI on Windows, Linux and macOS plus a pure-NumPy fallback.

milestones.title: Reproducible benchmark
milestones.goal: Receipted builds, hash-chained raw evidence and a qualified 1-CPU reference run.

milestones.title: Byte-exact strict mode
milestones.goal: `--mode strict` restores every byte and rejects the lossy `--rdo` and `--gpu` options.

milestones.title: Texture quality floor
milestones.goal: `--gpu auto` never ships a texture below the floor (default 35 dB RGB) or with altered opaque alpha.

milestones.title: Stream block layout
milestones.goal: Large assets get their own blocks: Kenney single-asset p99 5.96 → 0.36 ms for +0.4 % size.

milestones.title: Lossless Xonotic 0.80×
milestones.goal: Byte-exact strict archive of all 14,597 Xonotic 0.8.6 files at ≤ 0.80× the shipped download (948.1 MB): 924.6 MB.

milestones.title: Seekable compact archive
milestones.goal: Keep ≤ 0.80× on Xonotic while a cold single-asset read stays ≤ 5 ms p99 (compact today: 373 ms).

milestones.title: Mips, sRGB, DDS
milestones.goal: Full mip chains, sRGB/linear tag, DDS export and texture metadata in the C-ABI.

milestones.title: DXT ingest
milestones.goal: Read shipped DDS (DXT1/3/5 with mips) as GPU textures; add BC3 encode/decode with reference-decoder conformance.

milestones.title: RDO for shipped DXT
milestones.goal: Rate-distortion re-encoding of existing DXT blocks for the entropy coder, gated at 40 dB against the shipped texture.

milestones.title: Normal maps
milestones.goal: Detect normal maps; encode BC5 with renormalized mips.

milestones.title: Full BC7
milestones.goal: BC7 modes beyond 6 to cut the size cost of the quality floor (Xonotic +74 %).

milestones.title: KTX2 export
milestones.goal: KTX2 output for Vulkan, Bevy and Godot.

milestones.title: Mobile formats
milestones.goal: ASTC/ETC2; blocked on a reference-decoder conformance oracle.

milestones.title: Complete C-ABI
milestones.goal: Asset enumeration, thread-safe reads and readable error messages.

milestones.title: DarkPlaces backend
milestones.goal: Xonotic reads its data from a .vpak through a DarkPlaces filesystem backend; GPU textures upload as stored.

milestones.title: Real-GPU validation
milestones.goal: Upload and read back every format on real D3D12/Vulkan/OpenGL hardware; play the North-Star demo.

milestones.title: Lossless JPEG recompression
milestones.goal: Bit-exact recompression of the 173 MB of shipped JPEGs (Lepton-style).

milestones.title: Incremental repack
milestones.goal: Repack only the assets that changed.

milestones.title: Patch-friendly archives
milestones.goal: Measure and minimize archive bytes that change when one asset changes.

milestones.title: Faster VXLZ decode
milestones.goal: VXLZ decodes 2.4–4.6× slower than zstd on the same blocks.

milestones.title: Cold-disk benchmark
milestones.goal: Physical-IO protocol, separate from codec-cache resets.
